cards.title: Numerator Effect
cards.description: Ratio change caused by change in the numerator.

cards.title: Denominator Effect
cards.description: Ratio change caused by change in the normalizing denominator.

cards.title: Relative-Rate Identity
cards.description: Ratio relative change equals numerator relative change minus denominator relative change.

cards.title: Denominator Risk
cards.description: Near-zero denominators can destabilize interpretation and computation.
